title: Utility back on path A: closed-transition retransfer with the synchroscope (training mode)
summary: TRAINING MODE, outside the A3 design (which retransfers in open transition). Path A is on generators and the utility is back. The generator bus runs fast and out of phase. Trim the governor until the slip is inside the window, then give the closed-transition close: it is sync-check supervised, so 52-U closes by itself the instant the needle and the slip are inside the window (it waits up to 30 s, then cancels). The controller then opens 52-GM. Stop the sets. An open-transition retransfer fails this drill.

steps.text: Acknowledge the path A alarms in the alarm banner
Trim the governor until the slip is within +/-0.10 Hz (MV transfer A: LOWER / RAISE)
Close 52-U in sync (MV transfer A: Closed-transition retransfer, then EXECUTE; it closes when the window comes, within 30 s)
Stop the generator bus (MV transfer A: Stop generator bus)

fail.reason: open-transition retransfer used: this drill asks for a closed transition
